CustomField.description: The team member a reviewer chose to credit when the row's advisor name fits more than one member of a team code (flag ADVISOR_AMBIGUOUS), for example "Chen" on a team with Ryan and Megan Chen. Matching credits this advisor 100% if they hold the code on the trade date, and flags the row ADVISOR_FROM_REVIEWER. If left blank on accept, Claude's suggested advisor is used.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose which team member to credit when the advisor name on the row fits more than one of them.
CustomField.label: Advisor Override
